projects.title: Drone Charging Research
projects.description:
The purpose of this project is to develop proof-of-concept and proof-of-practicality by developing a prototype system that allows for automatic remote charging of drones. The vision behind this project is to provide an infrastructure for drones that is analogous to cars and gas stations. We envision a network that allows drones flying around (such as Amazon NOW drones) to have access to independently-run charging pads, so that drones that need charging can identify an available charging pad, navigate to that pad, charge, and pay the pad-owner for providing the service of charging. This project will focus on the second part: charging and payment, and is done in collaboration with the Research and Development division of Blockchain at Berkeley.

My part of the team was in charge of building the web server that handles messaging between charging pads and drones as well as payment between owner and client.

Technologies Used: Java, Servlets, Apache Tomcat, PayPal API, Arduino

projects.title: Preserve
projects.description:
- Food management & notification Android application
- Allows users to keep track of the food items they purchase and when they expire
- Makes use of OCR and receipt scanning to easily add food items to your personal “Fridge”
- Sends push notifications when your food is about to expire
- Available on the Google Play Store
- Technologies Used: Java, Android SDK, Firebase, Google Mobile Vision API
